  stdout is not a terminal; what `list --json` gains is a fork for the operator (the directive's item 3).
- **A reused name never inherits an old parent** — a parent belongs to one instance's launch, not to its name.
- **Parent kept by `revive`** — a revived instance keeps the parent its lineage recorded.
- **A parent edge is a drawing label only** — it never changes the wheel, the links or whether a `send` is accepted.

body: M1 — **the test run under the fake agent.** `cargo test --features fake-agent --test cli_list --test cli_links --test cli_revive --test cli_output_plain --test chaos_revive -- --test-threads 4` at f274938f: exit 0; `cli_list` 21 passed, `cli_links` 12, `cli_revive` 27, `cli_output_plain` 6, `chaos_revive` 1 — 67 passed, 0 failed (log: `$TMPDIR/{scratchpad}/p3-measure-1.log`, the five `test result:` lines read from it).

M2 — **the parent/child relation the tree holds today: none.** No event kind, snapshot field, board field or flag names a parent or a role: `viola_core::EventKind` holds 15 kinds (`crates/viola-core/src/lib.rs:58-94`, `ALL: [Self; 15]`), none of them a lineage kind; `InstanceSnapshot` holds `endpoint, pid, started_at, pinned_bin, cli_verified, cli_version, wheel, links, child_pid, pending_dialog, cwd, agent_session_id` (`src/run/mod.rs:29-44`, the test literal); `RunArgs` takes `name` and `program` only (`src/cmd/run.rs:43-50`); `ReviveArgs` takes `name, --id, --fork, --list, --json, extra` (`src/cmd/revive.rs:25-44`). A search of all seven masters for `lineage|\bparent\b` (`rec.py find --doc {each} --regex '(?i)lineage|\bparent\b'`) finds 0 lineage rows; its 16 hits are other senses of «parent» (the R8 parent-identity env floor, a parent directory, a parent-death kill).

M3 — **the one relation it does hold: observed links.** `driver -> driven` pairs, written only by the driven wrapper as `link` / `unlink` lines (`source: wrapper`, `{driver, driven}`), held in memory by `LinkSet` (`src/run/links.rs:21-137`), mirrored to `snapshot.json`'s `links` at each change (`links.rs:130-136`), rebuilt by the replay's one rule `replay::apply_link_line`, restored at EVERY start, `run` and `revive` alike, before the endpoint serves (`src/cmd/run.rs:338-343`). The driver is self-reported (`from`, or the `link` verb's argument) and need not be a booted instance.

M4 — **a reused name inherits its links today.** `links_survive_a_wrapper_restart` (`tests/cli_links.rs:224-256`, in M1's green run) boots a second `viola run` of the same name over the first life's log and asserts the snapshot's `links` equal the first life's. A `run` of a `gone` name is taken over in place (`collision_check`, `src/cmd/run.rs:461-488`: `Gone` → `None`), its `events.ndjson` appended to, never truncated. So a parent derived from the log by the link rule would ALSO be inherited by a reused name — the requirement's «a reused name never inherits an old parent» needs its own rule (see Mechanism).

M5 — **what `revive` keeps today.** `revive` runs `run`'s own `start` (`src/cmd/revive.rs:152-156` → `src/cmd/run.rs:264`) after its preflight; it keeps the instance's log (appended), its link set (restored by the shared start), the session it resumes (`session_chain` → `pick_session`, `revive.rs:218-253`) and the recorded `cwd` (only from a real snapshot, `recorded_dir`, `revive.rs:257-266`). It keeps no parent (none exists, M2).
M7 — **what a launch knows of its parent at the moment it starts.**

- Environment NAMES a `viola run` inherits when typed inside a wrapped session: `VIOLA_NAME`, `VIOLA_DIR`, `VIOLA_BIN` — set by that session's wrapper on its `claude` child (`run::child_launch`, `src/run/mod.rs:138-143`) and inherited by whatever the child starts; they are not `CLAUDE*`, so the R8 strip never touches them. `viola run` reads two of them today, only to resolve its HOME (`resolved_home` → `instance_of`, `src/cmd/mod.rs:255-300`: the pair must check as `<home>/instances/<name>`); it never reads `VIOLA_NAME` as its own name (obs-plan · decision/instance-source-per-role). Its own child gets ITS name over the inherited one (`child_launch` sets `VIOLA_NAME` last-writer).
- The socket: the parent's endpoint is recorded in the parent's `snapshot.json`; a start reads no other instance's snapshot today.
- The record: none — no file names the caller.

- What it CANNOT know: whether the inherited `VIOLA_NAME` is honest (self-reported, as `from` is: security-plan · decision/from-field-authenticates-nothing); whether the parent is live (unless it reads the parent's snapshot and liveness, which it does not); anything at all when typed in a plain shell or by a human outside a wrapped session (no `VIOLA_NAME`); the parent's session id or socket (only through the parent's state files).

M8 — **where a start's own lines land.** `start_state` appends one `wheel {holder:"driver", cause:"start"}` line after the first snapshot and the heartbeat, before the spawn (`src/cmd/run.rs:559-591`); the hook's `session-start` follows from the child. test-plan · contract/boot-readiness/events and contract/event-log/start-wheel-record pin «line 1 `wheel` start, line 2 `session-start`» for a booted instance; decision/start-lines-read-from-start-offset reads a start's lines from its own offset.
